p.t: Have I Got a Bit More News for You
p.d: Harry Hill is guest host as comedian Jack Dee and journalist Zing Tsjeng join team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop to delve into the news. [S]
The Games People Play: Jac manipulates events when Elliot's daughter Martha is assigned to shadow Joseph. Abra must think fast when Dan catches him taking more HIV drugs from the pharmacy. [S]
Love Hurts: Tess must confront her own problems when a pregnant woman is involved in a road accident. Robyn and Jamie witness the effects of a batch of bad pills on the Holby nightlife. [S,AD]
Happy and Glorious: Part 2: As Reg falls under deeper suspicion in relation to an elderly woman's death, his royal protection application falls by the wayside. [S]
New. Tamwar feels the pressure of his impending nuptials when Afia presents him with an impossible decision, while Yusef causes a stir when he suggests that Syed attends the wedding. [S]
New. Masood's desperate attempt to halt Tam and Afia's wedding is dealt a crushing blow, while Zainab is unsettled by Yusef's memories of their past. Shirley discovers Phil's secret. [S]
New. Insurance Assessor Richard Morrison knocks on the Ramsays' door. Des and Joan celebrate their engagement by hosting an engagement party. [S]
New. Eileen Clarke returns to Ramsay Street and meets Joan. Des Clarke contemplates significant changes in his personal life. Daphne invites Eileen over to dinner. [S]
Stiff Competition: Sister Boniface investigates a deadly magical mishap at the local talent show. [S,AD]
The Devil's Dust: Mystery from the mind of GK Chesterton. Father Brown joins the search when a girl who is believed to be radioactive goes missing overnight. [S,AD]
The Stalker: Judi Dench and Geoffrey Palmer are the middle-aged lovers in this romantic sitcom. Jean is concerned when Lionel comes to the rescue of his secretary, who is being stalked. [S]
The Defeat of the Stoneworm: Fun with the three young-at-heart Yorkshiremen, and Nora Batty, of course. Howard discovers an outbreak of a little-known household pest. [S]
Once in a Moonlit Junkyard: Classic comedy in the beautiful surrounds of Yorkshire. A sinister looking motorcyclist strikes the fear of God in Compo. [S]
The Space Ace: Vintage laughs with Compo and the gang. Alcohol threatens to interfere with the intensive training of Yorkshire's very first trainee astronaut. Foggy has an idea. [S]
The 13th Earl: Part 2: After notorious gangster Trent Wilsher is shot dead and Rory, the Earl of Davenstock - who is the prime suspect - disappears, Max launches a manhunt to find him. [S,AD]
Hard to Swallow: Part 1: A rat-nibbled body locked in a mine tunnel presents an intriguing mystery - especially when it's discovered the victim swallowed a key that could have set him free. [S,AD]

S1 E1 — Life on the EdgeWild and unpredictable, the Scandinavian coast is a place of haunting beauty and dangerous extremes. A journey from storm-swept islands crowded with seal pups to deep fjords where sea eagles fly and base jumpers parachute from the edge.

S1 E2 — HeartlandsGreat forests form the heart of Scandinavia, stretching towards the Arctic and cutting through with a labyrinth of waterways. A look at how incredible creatures like lynxes, wolves, bears and reindeer survive the ever-changing seasons.

S1 E3 — Fire and IceScandinavia's northern extremes have been shaped by ice and fire, but it's the sun that reigns over these frozen kingdoms. A look at how musk oxen, polar bears and arctic foxes endure the long, dark polar night.

S1 E1 — A Dangerous WorldThree charismatic animal families, capuchin monkeys, giant otters and coatis, strive to raise their families against a backdrop of extraordinary landscapes and huge extremes of weather.

A look at the beauty of the region's forests and waterways through the seasons, with ingenious ravens working together to outsmart golden eagles to get a meal, while osprey swoop down to catch fish from lakes shaped by beavers. In the spring, a wandering male lynx leaves his scent on a twisted pine, hoping to attract a mate, while a mother bear emerges from hibernation and tries to teach her playful cubs to climb

The dramatic extremes of the Nordic territories - volcanic Iceland, the high tundra and Arctic Svalbard - where polar bears, arctic foxes and musk ox must all survive in a world that ranges from total darkness to midnight sun. For some, winter is about resilience and scraping through until the summer feasts, but for others it's the summer heat that brings the greatest danger.

Stephen Mangan narrates a documentary following capuchin monkeys, giant otters and coatis as they strive to raise their families. The first episode sees the young animals taking their first steps in some of the world's most extraordinary habitats, where they have to beware of deadly predators including the jaguar and caiman

Rebecca Ferguson narrates a documentary exploring the wildlife, landscape and culture of the northern European region, beginning with a coastal journey from the sheltered Baltic Sea to the wild Atlantic Ocean, travelling north to freezing Arctic waters. Seal pups are born on granite islands left by the Ice Age, while flocks of migrant birds visit the largest tidal flats on the planet, and Europe's largest eagles patrol Norway's sea cliffs
